# `width` and `height` on a canvas are the coordinate space the shapes were
# placed in, not the size it is shown at. `scalingMode` is what happens to the
# picture when the room it is given is not that size.
#
# Each target already had a name for all four, so none of them needed a new
# mechanism -- only a value to read. html scales the backing store into the CSS
# box with object-fit, fyne has the four fill modes one for one, and Compose
# has no backing store to stretch so the shapes are scaled in the DrawScope.

sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o h fit.sngl
grep 'object-fit:contain' h/index.html
# The backing store keeps the size the shapes were placed at.
grep 'width="200px"' h/index.html
# And the prop is read here rather than passed through as an attribute no
# element has.
! grep 'scalingMode=' h/index.html

sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o hs stretch.sngl
grep 'object-fit:fill' hs/index.html

# center is the default, and adds nothing: the canvas stays the size of its
# own drawing, which is what every canvas did before there was a choice.
sngl generate --platform html --lang none -o hc center.sngl
! grep 'object-fit' hc/index.html

# Fyne's fill modes line up with the four names.
sngl generate --platform fyne --lang go -o f fit.sngl
grep 'FillMode = canvas.ImageFillContain' f/model.go
# A minimum is a floor rather than a size: without one the box gives a canvas
# nothing to scale into, which is a readout one pixel tall.
grep 'SetMinSize' f/model.go

sngl generate --platform fyne --lang go -o fc center.sngl
grep 'FillMode = canvas.ImageFillOriginal' fc/model.go

# Compose draws into the room it is laid out in, so the shapes are scaled.
sngl generate --platform android --lang kotlin -o a fit.sngl
grep 'aspectRatio\(200f / 100f\)' a/MainScreen.kt
grep 'scale\(scale = minOf\(size.width / 200f, size.height / 100f\)' a/MainScreen.kt

sngl generate --platform android --lang kotlin -o ac center.sngl
grep 'Modifier.size\(200.dp, 100.dp\)' ac/MainScreen.kt

-- fit.sngl --
import . "sngl:app"
import . "sngl:ui"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"

component main {
    window #w {
        draw.canvas(width=200px, height=100px, scalingMode=draw.ScalingMode.fit) {
            draw.rect(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=200.0, h=100.0, style=draw.CanvasStyle{fill=#3366cc})
        }
    }
}
-- stretch.sngl --
import . "sngl:app"
import . "sngl:ui"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"

component main {
    window #w {
        draw.canvas(width=200px, height=100px, scalingMode=draw.ScalingMode.stretch) {
            draw.rect(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=200.0, h=100.0, style=draw.CanvasStyle{fill=#3366cc})
        }
    }
}
-- center.sngl --
import . "sngl:app"
import . "sngl:ui"
import draw "sngl:ui/draw"

component main {
    window #w {
        draw.canvas(width=200px, height=100px) {
            draw.rect(x=0.0, y=0.0, w=200.0, h=100.0, style=draw.CanvasStyle{fill=#3366cc})
        }
    }
}
